docs.title: aibi-toolkit
docs.text:
CLI + library for cleaning up Power BI / Tableau semantic-model metadata.

pip install .
aibi --help
Command Purpose summary object counts audit hygiene findings + score lint DAX rule findings export measures to CSV diagram mermaid ER diagram fix naming/format auto-fixes report markdown audit report synth demo model generator

docs.title: Using the toolkit
docs.text:
Start with the quick audit example in the repo, or dive into the pages below for each command family:

  • Naming and format strings
  • Auditing and linting
  • Autofixes and profiling
  • Diagrams and the CLI reference

New in v0.8: aibi profile for expression complexity, role-playing dimension detection, and word/naming utilities.

docs.title: CLI reference
docs.text: Every command takes a model JSON path first. Output-oriented commands (export, report, synth) take a destination path second.

docs.title: Auditing
docs.text:
aibi audit model.json

Exits non-zero when findings exist, so it works as a CI gate:

- run: aibi audit model.json

docs.title: Score
docs.text: The 0-100 score penalizes missing formats (heaviest), duplicate names, and overly long names.

docs.title: Relationship checks
docs.text: integrity.check_relationships flags inactive and bidirectional relationships; check_cardinality flags missing cardinality.

docs.title: Auto-fixes
docs.text:
aibi fix model.json          # prints fixes and the updated model JSON
aibi fix --dry-run model.json  # prints fixes only

Fixes are naming normalizations and format-string suggestions. Review the change log before applying to a real model.

docs.title: DAX snippets
docs.text: Available builders: SUM, DISTINCTCOUNT, DIVIDE-ratio, TOTALYTD, TOTALQTD, MoM, prior-YoY, running total, RANKX, ALLSELECTED baseline.

docs.title: Diagrams
docs.text:
aibi diagram model.json

Paste the mermaid output into any markdown file, GitHub issue, or PR — GitHub renders erDiagram blocks natively.

docs.title: Linting DAX
docs.text:
aibi lint model.json

Rules: - Prefer DIVIDE over / - Avoid IFERROR (hides real errors) - Avoid no-argument ALLSELECTED

docs.title: Rule list
docs.text: Rule Why divert-by-DIVIDE divide-by-zero errors no IFERROR hides real failures no bare ALLSELECTED() ambiguous in visuals

docs.title: Naming conventions
docs.text:
• Tables: plain plural nouns ("Orders", "Customers")
  • Columns: snake_case in source, Title Case for display
  • Measures: aggregation prefix ("Total", "Count of", "Average")

docs.title: Anti-patterns
docs.text:
• Mixing abbreviations with full words in the same table
  • Measure names that duplicate column names
  • Spaces at the start or end of any object name

docs.title: Style conversions
docs.text: to_snake_case, kebab_case, pascal_case, to_display_name — pick one convention per layer and stick to it.

docs.title: Profiling
docs.text:
aibi profile model.json

Every CALCULATE, FILTER, VAR and RETURN adds weight. Weights of 5+ are flagged as heavy candidates for analysis.
